## Description {#details}

<p>Common base class for representing values projected from a statepoint.</p>


<p>Currently, the only projections available are gc.result and gc.relocate.</p>


<p>Definition at line 1778 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/ir/intrinsicinst-h">IntrinsicInst.h</a>.</p>
